correctness.rationale: In the canonical incidence representation, a cover-supported power has the product along a unique path at each possible entry, with no cancellation. For fixed k, rows from one depth have disjoint descendant supports; rows from different depths end at different depths. Thus rank X^k counts vertices whose longest open descent is at least k, and second rank differences give the exact Jordan multiplicities through size h+1. In the polynomial recursion, at cutoff j each child independently contributes its unrestricted assignment with a closed edge, or its root-length-at-most-j-1 assignments with one of q-1 nonzero connecting weights. The difference of consecutive cumulative polynomials therefore counts the exact root length with nonnegative coefficients, including j=0; marking the root and starting with the single leaf proves the full census and coefficient sum q^E. For the maximal index, root survival is the stated branching recurrence; strict concavity and bt>1 give the unique positive fixed point and iteration from 1, with the binary formula by solving the quadratic. At (2,2) the reciprocal increments tend to 1/4, proving p_a~4/a. The global deficit is h-max_v L(v): for a descent of length h-k only depths through k are possible, giving the union bound, while the b^k disjoint depth-k subtrees give independent opportunities. At k=floor(log_2 h)-L and +L these bounds give opposite tail estimates of order 2^(-L) and exp(-c 2^L) for sufficiently large h at fixed L; a positive survival lower bound yields uncentered tightness in the other fixed regimes. This is tightness, not convergence to a critical lattice law. In the whole radical a strict chain of h steps must increase depth by one at each step from the root, so all noncover coefficients are free for the top-power count only; R=sum d b^d counts strict ancestors. Inspected frozen programs and recorded outputs; the separate bounded `python3 -B /workspace/review_evidence/small_field_checks.py` computed actual matrix powers and ranks for all 4096 F4 binary-height-two edge assignments and matched the five exact rank pairs. This does not stand in for the all-parameter proof.
